name: Kawasaki ZRX1100 / ZRX1200
engine: 1052 or 1164 cc liquid-cooled DOHC inline four, four carbs
intro: Kawasaki's retro muscle bike. Strong and simple. Carb sync and the charging system are the usual jobs.

G: If it sat, clean the carbs and set float levels. Sync them after.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Carbs
known.what: The Keihin CVK carbs gum up and need cleaning if the bike sat.
